youll have to shrinkwrap.

One easy way to avoid a lot of shrinkwrap changes:

``` sh
# remove the package.json change
rm -rf node_modules
npm cache clean
npm install
rm -rf node_modules #yes..
npm install # from cache..
npm install algoliasearch-helper@2.6.1 --save
npm install algoliasearch-helper@2.6.1 --save
npm shrinkwrap
```

Yes that's the way to "upgrade a package when using shrinkwrap", the easiest and safest.
